# `stop_task`

**Stop a running task.** Stop the agent working on a task and leave the task blocked.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `stop_task` |
| Side effect | `update` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
| Defined in | [`src/commands/contracts/builtin.py`](../../../src/commands/contracts/builtin.py) |
| Contract fingerprint | `sha256:1449c6b66c59f22bafd4cdf936dff5ac5b7348e095de0a96efe4c745f017d34a` |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | `string` | yes | — | Task |

## Result

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `stopped` | `string` | Stopped task |

## Outcomes

|---|---|---|

| `rejected` | failure | Rejected |
| `stopped` | success | Stopped |

## Declared effects
